films.title: Coral Reef Aquarium 4K 60fps | 1 Hour Relaxing Underwater Ambience (No Music)
films.description:
One hour of calm coral reef in 4K 60fps - underwater ambience with no music, for sleep, study, focus or relaxation.

Save the aquarium ambience playlist for your next session:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLA9MfcqwJiD4

Subscribe for new underwater ambience: https://www.youtube.com/@Greenfield.Ambience

Clownfish nestle in their anemones, blue tangs and moorish idols drift through the kelp, a lionfish patrols the rocks, a manta ray glides overhead and a school of silver fish wheels past, while sunlight ripples across the sand.

This reef is a real-time 3D world by Greenfield Studio. The fish models were made with the help of generative AI, and the corals are museum scans (CC0); the scene, the way every fish swims, the light and the sound are ours. Nothing in this video loops: every fish swims by its own behaviour, and the soft underwater soundscape (deep swell, water movement, bubbles and the crackle of snapping shrimp) is generated live, so it never repeats.

Perfect as:
- background for sleep, study or deep work
- a calm aquarium on your TV or second screen
- relaxation and stress relief

Made by Greenfield Studio: https://www.youtube.com/@Greenfield.Studio
